claims.claim: The page teaches how to scaffold new PromptArena test projects using templates
The promptarena init command uses templates to generate complete, ready-to-use test projects
promptarena init my-test --quick --provider mock is a valid command
init accepts a --quick flag
init accepts a --provider flag
mock is a valid value for --provider
openai is a valid value for --provider
Quick mode uses sensible defaults
Quick mode creates config.arena.yaml in the project root
Quick mode writes `prompts/assistant.prompt.yaml`.
Quick mode writes `providers/<provider>.provider.yaml`.
Quick mode writes `scenarios/basic-test.scenario.yaml`.
Quick mode creates a .env file with placeholders for API keys
Quick mode creates a .gitignore that ignores .env and temporary files
Quick mode creates README.md
PromptArena includes 6 built-in templates
`basic-chatbot` is a community template; the built-ins are quick-start, code-assistant, content-generation, customer-support, mcp-integration, multimodal.
customer-support is a built-in template with a support agent that has a KB and order tools
code-assistant is a built-in template with separate generator and reviewer prompts
content-generation is a built-in template for creative content
multimodal is a built-in template with vision analysis and image inputs
mcp-integration is a built-in template with an MCP filesystem server configuration
`templates list` prints built-in templates first, then index entries.
The default community template index points to the promptkit-templates repo
promptarena templates list lists remote templates from the default index
promptarena templates fetch --template NAME --version VERSION fetches a remote template into the cache
templates fetch accepts a --version flag
promptarena templates render --template NAME --version VERSION --values FILE --out DIR renders a template
templates render accepts a --values flag
templates render accepts an --out flag
promptarena templates update updates all cached templates
promptarena init my-project --template NAME --template-index URL initialises a project from a remote template
init accepts a --template flag
init accepts a --template-index flag
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AltairaLabs/promptkit-templates/main/index.yaml is a reachable template index
--index is an accepted alias for the template index override
--template-index overrides the index URL or path
--cache-dir is an accepted flag that overrides the template cache location
--template-cache is an accepted flag that overrides the template cache location
--values and --set provide variables for render
The mock provider needs no API key
openai is a provider type that init can scaffold
claude is a valid value for --provider
gemini is a valid value for --provider
Running promptarena init my-project without --quick starts an interactive prompt session
Interactive mode prompts for the project name (only when none is given), the provider, and `include_env`.
Interactive mode prompts for provider selection
Interactive mode prompts for system prompt customisation
Interactive mode prompts for temperature and max tokens
Interactive mode prompts for test scenario details
Temperature prompt accepts a range of 0.0 to 2.0
The interactive prompt label is `Project name`, default `my-arena-tests`.
Interactive provider prompt offers openai as a choice
Interactive mode asks whether to create a sample test scenario
Interactive mode asks for a scenario name
config.arena.yaml uses apiVersion promptkit.altairalabs.ai/v1alpha1
config.arena.yaml uses kind Arena
config.arena.yaml metadata.name is set from the project name
Arena spec.prompt_configs is a list whose entries have id and file fields
Arena spec.providers is a list whose entries have a file field
Arena spec.scenarios is a list whose entries have a file field
prompts/assistant.yaml uses apiVersion promptkit.altairalabs.ai/v1alpha1 and kind PromptConfig
PromptConfig spec.task_type is a field
PromptConfig spec.system_prompt is a field
PromptConfig spec.defaults is an object
The generated prompt defaults set temperature to 0.7
The generated prompt defaults set max_tokens to 2000
providers/openai.yaml uses kind Provider
The generated OpenAI provider is named openai-gpt4o-mini
Provider spec.type is a field and openai is a valid type
The generated OpenAI provider uses model gpt-4o-mini
Provider spec.defaults is an object with temperature and max_tokens
scenarios/basic-test.yaml uses kind Scenario
The generated scenario metadata.name is basic-test
Scenario spec.task_type and spec.description are fields
Scenario spec.turns is a list whose entries have role and content fields
A turn accepts an assertions list
content_matches is a registered assertion type
content_matches takes a params object with pattern and message
The .env file sets OPENAI_API_KEY
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is the API key env var for the Claude provider
GOOGLE_API_KEY is the API key env var for the Gemini provider
promptarena run runs the tests in a generated project
promptarena run writes output/results.json
Keys are exported in the shell; `.env.example` only lists the variables.
All generated files are standard PromptKit YAML
`prompts/assistant.prompt.yaml` is the generated prompt file.
scenarios/advanced-test.yaml is a valid path for an added scenario
providers/claude.yaml is a valid path for an added provider file
promptarena init learning --quick --provider mock creates a project named learning
A quick-mode project has config.arena.yaml, prompts/assistant.prompt.yaml and scenarios/basic-test.scenario.yaml.
promptarena init dev-test --quick --provider mock is a valid command
Mock provider responses are instant and free
The mock provider file is `providers/mock.provider.yaml`.
providers/mock.yaml has a type field that can be changed to openai
Generated projects include a .gitignore
git init, git add and git commit are standard and work on a generated project
promptarena init customer-support --quick --provider openai is valid
promptarena init content-generation --quick --provider claude is valid
promptarena init qa-testing --quick --provider mock is valid
Quick mode with `--provider openai` writes the tree shown on the page.
The openai quick-mode project contains the tree shown on the page.
`init` into an existing directory keeps files sharing a generated name; `--force` overwrites.
Kept files are listed as `kept existing <file> (not overwritten; use --force to replace it)`.
Valid providers are mock, openai, claude and gemini
The provider error reads `--provider "anthropic" is not offered by template quick-start (choose one of: mock, openai, claude, gemini)`.
Generated projects create .env with placeholder API key values
Export the key in the shell; `promptarena` does not read `.env` files.

promptarena does not load .env files; .env.example only lists the variables to export
Quick mode creates a .env.example file listing the API keys to export
promptarena templates list prints the built-in templates first, then the index entries
templates fetch and templates render default --version to the latest version in the index
